vectors.description: The smallest visible cursor: 1×1, hotspot (0,0), one opaque blue BGRA pixel (FF 00 00 FF) — the hand-computed anchor: 24 ‖ 0100 ‖ 0100 ‖ 0000 ‖ 0000 ‖ ff0000ff.
vectors.name: shape-1x1-minimal

vectors.description: 2×2 with hotspot (1,1) — the last legal hotspot corner — and four distinct BGRA pixels, pinning row order (top row first) and the LE u16 fields.
vectors.name: shape-2x2-nominal

vectors.description: width ≠ height (4×2, hotspot (3,0)) — a transposed decode cannot pass; the LE width/height fields land in the right slots.
vectors.name: shape-4x2-asymmetric

vectors.description: The hidden state: all four u16 fields zero, no pixel bytes — nine bytes total, and unlike clipboard EMPTY IS A STATE (the cursor plane holds fb 0).
vectors.name: hidden

vectors.description: The 256 side cap exactly, legal: 256×1 (a maximal beam), hotspot (255,0) — the last legal hotspot on the cap side.
vectors.name: shape-side-cap-256x1

vectors.description: The exact image ceiling as legal bytes: 128×128 = 65,536 BGRA bytes (area 16,384 px), hotspot (64,64).
vectors.name: shape-max-budget-128x128

vectors.description: Type byte plus half a header (5 of 9 bytes).
vectors.name: truncated-header

vectors.description: A repair-refusal type byte (0x23) wearing a cursor header.
vectors.name: foreign-type

vectors.description: width 0 with height 2 — zero is all-or-nothing.
vectors.name: lone-zero-side

vectors.description: width 257 (0101 LE) — one past the DRM cursor cap.
vectors.name: side-over-cap

vectors.description: 256×256 = 262,144 B — dims legal per side, area past the 65,536 B ceiling (judged before the count, so no pixel bytes are needed to pin it).
vectors.name: image-over-budget

vectors.description: 2×2 with hotspot (2,0) — the hotspot must be strictly inside the image.
vectors.name: hotspot-at-edge

vectors.description: Hidden (0×0) with hotspot (1,0) — a hidden cursor has no image to click in.
vectors.name: hidden-nonzero-hotspot

vectors.description: wireDefault's frozen encoding plus exactly the appended `0D F5` entry (map head 0xA8 → 0xA9): the cursorShape accessor must read true and the set must re-encode byte-exactly — the "no frozen bytes moved" claim as data.
vectors.name: capability-key13-declared

vectors.description: wireDefault's frozen encoding unchanged: absence reads false — "not supported", never an error.
vectors.name: capability-key13-absent

vectors.description: Clipboard and cursor spine keys together: map head 0xAA with `0A F5 0D F5` trailing in canonical order — the two features compose without moving each other's bytes.
vectors.name: capability-key10-and-key13
